```
def render_table_cell(renderer: 'BaseRenderer', text: str, align: Optional[
    str]=None, head: bool=False) ->str:
    attrs = []
    if align:
        attrs.append(f'style="text-align: {align}"')
    if head:
        tag = 'th'
    else:
        tag = 'td'
    if attrs:
        attr_str = ' ' + ' '.join(attrs)
    else:
        attr_str = ''
    return f"<{tag}{attr_str}>{text}</{tag}>"
```
